title: BCG growth-share portfolio
goal: A portfolio manager can distinguish Stars, Cash Cows, Question Marks and Dogs while reading market positions and revenue bubbles.

rubric.must: BCG quadrant labels and four named product bubbles are visible.
Market share and growth-rate axes visibly orient the portfolio.
Bubble area visibly differentiates the products' relative revenue.
Product labels are readable without overlap.
Quadrant background or dividing lines make the four strategic regions clear.
